subject: Warm intro: WellPath Health — co-sell kickoff & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@wellpathhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Warm intro: WellPath x Redwood — interest in AWS co-sell

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick connect last week at the healthtech forum. We ran an internal product/partnership sync and think Redwood Inference could help reduce inference cost and latency for a couple of our ML-powered features (patient triage and clinical summarization). AWS suggested a co-sell introduction to align on listing + mutual action plan.

Key asks from our side:
- Quick intro call with your co-sell team + AWS to discuss mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline
- Clarify procurement path and any marketplace listing prerequisites (SOC2, data residency, contract cadence)
- High-level technical checklist so we can scope integration effort

Our first-pass stakeholders: Tom Reed (Head of Platform), Lina Gomez (Security lead), and procurement (we'll confirm contact).

Are you available for a 30–45m call next week? We prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Sarah Collins
Director, Partnerships
WellPath Health
[s]arah.collins@wellpathhealth.com

Subject: Re: Warm intro: WellPath x Redwood — co-sell kickoff & stakeholder alignment

Hi Sarah — great to hear and excited to engage. Copying the core Redwood + AWS partner contacts so we can land a MAP and list readiness checklist.

Quick proposed plan:
1) 30m kickoff (intro + goals) — attendees: Redwood sales (me, Ben), Redwood technical (Laura), AWS partner manager (Aaron), WellPath stakeholders
2) Follow-up 60m technical scoping with Redwood solutions + WellPath engs to walk integration points and perf targets
3) Draft MAP and marketplace prerequisites (security, contract steps) within 5 business days of kickoff

Proposed agenda for the kickoff (30m):
- 5m intros
- 10m customer goals + expected timeline / success metrics
- 10m Redwood brief (architecture, hosting options, privacy controls) + AWS co-sell alignment
- 5m next steps and immediate actions (procurement and security owners)

Suggested times (PT): Tue 2027-04-06 09:00 / 10:30 or Wed 2027-04-07 08:30. If none work, send a couple of alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Attaching a short AWS co-sell checklist we use to speed reviews. Also sending a MoM template we'll use to track action items.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

Redwood Inference
